A failure with no guard is 'open', never called fixed. scripts/check_failures.py checks each guard is still in place and CI runs it, so removing one fails the build. Read it at the start of any session: `python3 scripts/check_failures.py`. Krish, 2026-10-14: "how are you going to ensure all this stuff and all the other issues we've had today can never be had again in a 100% guaranteed durable way?"
